title: LA City General Fund postings, October 2025 vs October 2024

attempts.text: The City of Los Angeles General Fund posted a $54.8 million increase in October 2025 compared to the same month last year, marking a 7.6% increase from the $726.0 million posted in October 2024. This growth is attributed to a $64.3 million increase in Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration, a $129.9 million increase in Fire, and a $101.1 million increase in Police. The increase in Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration is particularly noteworthy as it is the largest mover in the General Fund, with a $64.3 million increase compared to the $43.6 million posted last year.

final_text: General Fund postings were $780.9m in October 2025, up 7.6% from $726.0m in October 2024. Year-to-date postings were $2.90bn, up 2.1%. The largest movements were: Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration increased by $64.3m; Fire decreased by $21.4m; Police increased by $13.9m.
